result.axis: CHALLENGE-L — library structure: module boundaries, ownership, dependency direction, public surface (subject: demo/picker/ColorPicker.vue)
result.modelObserved: Opus 5 (1M context) — exact model id claude-opus-5[1m]; the tier explicitly declared at spawn, not inherited
result.strongestDefect: L-1: src/color/model.ts implements and exports SPACE_SCHEMA (:56), SPACE_IDS (:76), isAnyColor (:127) and makeColor(space, channels, alpha) (:136) — the generic runtime-dispatched constructor — but src/color/index.ts re-exports NONE of them, so they are absent from src/subpaths/color.ts and from the published @mkbabb/value.js/color surface (verified by importing dist/subpaths/color.js: all four ABSENT; dist/subpaths/color.d.ts contains 0 occurrences). They are load-bearing internally (src/color/operations.ts:13,14,45,53,122,162,172,224; src/css/grammar.ts:16,290). Consequence: demo/color-session/picker-color.ts — the module the whole picker subtree computes through — reconstructs the withheld surface: :52-70 PICKER_CHANNELS re-declares the 17-space channel table (its hue? column is SPACE_SCHEMA.hueIndex re-expressed), :92-95 CSS_PICKER_SPACES is byte-identical to src/css/grammar.ts:161-164, and :123-144 buildColor() is a 22-line 17-case switch that is makeColor with type safety stripped, sitting in the slider hot path (withChannel/withAlpha/clampPickerColor all funnel through it). The library's public surface is defined by what its own flagship demo could not use.
result.negativeProof: Not applicable to the overall verdict (DEFECTIVE), but four axes were interrogated and proved clean, recorded in the report's "Proved negatives" section: (1) the demo consumes value.js ONLY through the published export map — all 51 @mkbabb/value.js import sites in demo/ use bare subpath specifiers, zero deep paths, zero @src into src/ internals; the vite aliases are GENERATED from package.json#exports (vite.config.ts:36-50) and resolve to dist/, so a demo import a real consumer could not write is structurally impossible. (2) The three-parallel-useDark suspect is cured — one authority (glass-ui useGlobalDark) at all 10 demo call sites incl. both picker-subtree ones (ConsoleRail.vue:127, HeroBlob.vue:94); useMarkdownHighlighting.ts:70-80 documents the kill. (3) No component is imported both directly from glass-ui and via a demo/ui barrel — direct root-specifier imports are only composables (useClipboard, useTouchGate, writeClipboard). (4) demo/palettes/export.ts / usePaletteExport.ts / export/serializers are entirely outside this component's import cone. (5) ActionBarLayer's local useLayerTransition reimplementation is not present in the current file. (6) pageErrors 0, horizontalOverflow 0, blankOrNearBlank 0 across all 60 visual captures.

defects.defect: The published @mkbabb/value.js/color surface withholds SPACE_SCHEMA, SPACE_IDS, makeColor and isAnyColor — all implemented and module-exported in src/color/model.ts — so the flagship consumer re-implements the whole abstraction in the demo, including a 17-case switch that is makeColor with type safety stripped.
defects.evidence: src/color/model.ts:56 (SPACE_SCHEMA), :76 (SPACE_IDS), :127 (isAnyColor), :136 (makeColor). src/color/index.ts (41 lines) re-exports none. Pasted run: `node --input-type=module -e "await import('./dist/subpaths/color.js')"` -> published exports: a98Rgb, convertColor, displayP3, hsl, hsv, hwb, ictcp, interpolateHue, jzazbz, kelvin, lab, lch, linearSrgb, mapColorToGamut, mixColors, oklab, oklch, prophotoRgb, rec2020, rgb, safeAccentColor, toRgba8, xyz; makeColor -> ABSENT, SPACE_SCHEMA -> ABSENT, SPACE_IDS -> ABSENT, isAnyColor -> ABSENT. `grep -c 'makeColor|SPACE_SCHEMA' dist/subpaths/color.d.ts` = 0. Duplicates: demo/color-session/picker-color.ts:52-70 (PICKER_CHANNELS), :92-95 (CSS_PICKER_SPACES, byte-identical to src/css/grammar.ts:161-164), :123-144 (buildColor). Corroboration: across all of demo/picker/** the only library import is `clamp` from @mkbabb/value.js/math (4 sites); ColorPicker.vue imports zero value.js.
defects.mechanism: Barrel under-export: the module layer implements the right abstraction, the public barrel withholds it, so every dynamic-space consumer must re-derive both the schema and the generic constructor.
defects.reproduction: cd /Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js && node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('./dist/subpaths/color.js'); for (const w of ['makeColor','SPACE_SCHEMA','SPACE_IDS','isAnyColor']) console.log(w, w in m ? 'PRESENT' : 'ABSENT');"
defects.proposedCure: Publish the schema and the generic constructor: src/color/index.ts re-exports SPACE_SCHEMA, SPACE_IDS, makeColor, isAnyColor; src/subpaths/color.ts follows. Extend SPACE_SCHEMA channels to {key,min,max,unit,hue} (the library already privately owns those bounds — it clamps kelvin at model.ts:91 and gamut-maps against them). Then delete from the demo: buildColor, CSS_PICKER_SPACES, and the channel-name/hue columns of PICKER_CHANNELS; picker-color.ts collapses to a thin Result->throw adapter.

defects.defect: App-scoped state (ActionBarContext + the colour-edit state machine) lives inside a KeepAlive'd route-leaf component and is reached by instance ref; the mobile mount path never captures that ref, so the picker's entire dock action bar is absent at mobile widths.
defects.evidence: ColorPicker.vue:315-328 builds actionBarContext; :331-344 defineExpose. App.vue:38 `:action-bar="colorPickerRef?.actionBarContext ?? null"`, :41-42 commit/cancel, :342 usePaneRouter, :351 usePaletteWiring. colorPickerRef is populated only by onDesktopLeftMount (App.vue:323-328), wired to the desktop PaneSlots at :105 and :131; the mobile PaneSlot at App.vue:83-91 passes no :on-mount, and PaneSlot.vue:124 renders `:ref="onMount ? ... : undefined"`. MEASURED live at http://localhost:9000/#/ : at 1440x900 nav exposes Back, Reset color, Copy color, Random color, Palettes, Extract palette, Open color input; at 390x844 (data-layout=mobile) it exposes NONE and the #action-bar DockLayer is absent from the DOM (actionBarLayerPresent:false), with the toggle surviving as a 32x32 button inside a 0-width .action-bar-toggle-slot at tabindex=-1. Corroborated by the shipped shots: safari-desktop-light/picker.png shows the 'Tools' group; safari-mobile-light/picker.png does not.
defects.mechanism: Ownership inversion — state whose lifetime must be the app's is assembled in a component whose lifetime is a pane-routing accident, then reached imperatively through a template ref captured on only one of two mount paths.
defects.reproduction: With the dev server on :9000, open http://localhost:9000/#/ at 1440x900 and evaluate `[...document.querySelectorAll('nav button')].map(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-label'))` -> includes 'Reset color','Copy color','Random color','Palettes','Extract palette','Open color input'. Resize to 390x844, reload http://localhost:9000/#/, evaluate the same -> none of those six; `!!document.querySelector('nav [id="action-bar"]')` -> false.
defects.proposedCure: Move ActionBarContext and the commit/cancel edit machine into a color-session composable (useColorEditSession / useActionBarContext) provided by App beside COLOR_MODEL_KEY; the Dock injects it. defineExpose and colorPickerRef disappear entirely, and with them usePaletteWiring's picker parameter and its retry loop.

defects.defect: Four of ColorPicker.vue's import edges violate the repository's own declared import-direction law in docs/tranches/V/ARCHITECTURE.md §1 (lines 47-58) — feature->app, feature->shell, feature->another feature's internal, plus a forwarding directory forbidden by name.
defects.evidence: Law: ARCHITECTURE.md:47-58 `feature -> color-session / own descendants / platform / shared / published packages` and line 58 'Cross-feature internal imports are forbidden by construction'; line 39 'There is no ... one-line glass-ui forwarding directory'. Violations: ColorPicker.vue:108 `../ui/card` (forwarding dir); :129 `../color-picker/composables/boot/useOverture` (feature->app composition root; demo/color-picker/ holds App.vue, router/, index.html, boot/ and is not even the declared name — the tree says demo/app/); :130 `../shell/useViewManager` (feature->shell; used only for paletteActive at :313); :131 `../palettes/usePalettePorts` (cross-feature internal; used only for paletteManager.commitColorEdit at :294 — a palette-domain write executed from inside the picker). Directory-level cycle: App.vue:164 imports ../picker, usePaletteWiring.ts:21 imports its type, while ColorPicker.vue:129 imports back into color-picker/.
defects.mechanism: Layer inversion: a route leaf reaches upward into boot, shell and a sibling feature for state that belongs in color-session or the shell.
defects.reproduction: cd /Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js && sed -n '108,141p' demo/picker/ColorPicker.vue && sed -n '47,58p' docs/tranches/V/ARCHITECTURE.md
defects.proposedCure: Overture beat B4 arrives as a shell-owned provide (or the shell owns the reveal class outright). paletteActive is computed in the Dock. The edit-commit inverts: the picker emits an intent, color-session's edit session owns the commit, palettes/ subscribes — the picker never names palettes/ again.

defects.defect: usePaletteWiring routes four cross-cutting colour operations through the picker COMPONENT INSTANCE and silently swaps to different semantics when it is absent — three masking fallbacks plus a 2-second polling retry with a give-up console.warn.
defects.evidence: demo/color-picker/composables/usePaletteWiring.ts:65-73 emitApply — picker present -> onPaletteApply(colors) (replaces savedColors with ALL parsed colours); absent -> applyColorString(colors[0]) (sets the CURRENT colour to the first entry, touches no palette). :121-127 emitSetCurrentColor — applyExternalColor vs applyColorString; these are two near-identical implementations in one file (useColorPipeline.ts:182-188 and :247-257): one calls setCurrentColor (refreshing stableHue) and throws on parse failure, the other calls updateModel and swallows the error. :33-58 whenColorPickerReady polls 40 x 50ms then console.warn('gave up waiting for the color picker to mount'), which on mobile ALWAYS exhausts, so emitStartEdit (:106-119) is dead. All of these are pure pipeline calls: App.vue:245 already holds `pipeline` directly, and 5 of ColorPicker's 12 defineExpose members are straight re-exports of inject(COLOR_MODEL_KEY).
defects.mechanism: Dual path with masking fallback — the same public operation resolves to two different implementations depending on whether an unrelated component happens to be mounted.
defects.reproduction: Read demo/color-picker/composables/usePaletteWiring.ts:33-127 alongside demo/color-session/useColorPipeline.ts:182-188 and :247-257. Behavioural repro: at 390x844 (where colorPickerRef is permanently null per L-2) applying a saved palette loads only its first colour into the current swatch instead of replacing savedColors, and starting a palette colour edit logs the give-up warning after ~2s.
defects.proposedCure: Delete the picker parameter, the retry loop and both fallback arms; call the pipeline directly. Then reconcile applyExternalColor and applyColorString into one named operation in color-session.

defects.defect: The picker registers a window-level keydown listener in onMounted and releases it only in onUnmounted, but is rendered inside <KeepAlive>, so leaving the picker view deactivates rather than unmounts it and the global shortcut stays live on every other route.
defects.evidence: ColorPicker.vue:376-379 onMounted -> window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown); :381-385 onUnmounted -> removeEventListener + two debounce cancels. PaneSlot.vue:120 wraps the pane in <KeepAlive :max="max">. MEASURED live at 1440x900: (1) on #/ fire Cmd+K -> 'Select color space' aria-expanded='true' and [role=listbox] present; (2) Cmd+K again -> closed; (3) navigate to #/browse -> the picker Select is absent from the DOM (pane deactivated); (4) fire Cmd+K on #/browse; (5) navigate back to #/ -> aria-expanded='true', [role=listbox] present. The deactivated picker consumed a global shortcut from a route it does not own. The same hole leaves parseAndSetColorDebounced (2000ms) and updateColorComponentDebounced (500ms) uncancelled on every view switch. Compounding: two keyboard mechanisms for one shortcut set — useMagicKeys() at :247 plus the raw window handler that reads magic-keys state at :263.
defects.mechanism: Wrong lifecycle pair under KeepAlive: onMounted/onUnmounted instead of onActivated/onDeactivated, in a component whose owner caches it.
defects.reproduction: With the dev server on :9000 at 1440x900, in the page context: navigate to '#/', dispatch KeyboardEvent keydown {key:'Meta'} then {key:'k',metaKey:true} on window -> the colour-space Select opens; dispatch again to close; set location.hash='#/browse', wait for the swap, dispatch the same pair; set location.hash='#/' -> the Select is open again (aria-expanded='true').
defects.proposedCure: The shortcut is app-level: move it to a shell-owned keyboard-map composable registered once at the composition root that dispatches to the active instrument. The picker keeps no window listener. Any listener that must live in a KeepAlive'd leaf uses onActivated/onDeactivated.

defects.defect: demo/ui/ is 19 one-line glass-ui forwarding directories with 90 import sites — a directory level the repository's own architecture forbids by name — and it creates a de-facto dual spelling of the same package.
defects.evidence: `wc -l demo/ui/*/index.ts | tail -1` -> 29 total across 19 directories; `grep -rn 'from "[./]*ui/[a-z-]*"' demo --include='*.vue' --include='*.ts' | wc -l` -> 90. Every barrel is a bare re-export, e.g. demo/ui/card/index.ts is one line: `export { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";`. ARCHITECTURE.md:39 forbids exactly this ('no ... one-line glass-ui forwarding directory'), and demo/ui/ is not in the declared tree — the declared home is shared/ui/ for 'only genuinely app-owned controls with 2+ consumers' (today EmptyState.vue, PaneHeader.vue). Picker sites: ColorPicker.vue:108, ColorComponentDisplay.vue:54, ComponentSliders.vue:95-96, ConsoleRail.vue:90. Meanwhile composables arrive direct: ColorPicker.vue:138 writeClipboard, SpectrumCanvas.vue:39 useTouchGate, App.vue:191 useClipboard.
defects.mechanism: A pure indirection layer surviving from a retired shadcn-local-copy era: components arrive via a forwarding barrel, composables arrive direct, so one package has two spellings decided by kind.
defects.reproduction: cd /Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js && for d in demo/ui/*/; do echo "--- $d"; cat "$d"index.ts; done | head -60 && grep -rn 'from "[./]*ui/[a-z-]*"' demo --include='*.vue' --include='*.ts' | wc -l
defects.proposedCure: Delete all 19 directories and rewrite the 90 import sites to @mkbabb/glass-ui and its declared subpaths — a mechanical zero-behaviour change that removes a prohibited level.

defects.defect: ColorPicker.vue holds a second, incorrect implementation of CSS hex validity, and is the fifth of eleven homes for the 'hex is a display encoding, not a space' special case.
defects.evidence: ColorPicker.vue:224-234 gates on /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$/ before calling parseAndSetColor. Pasted run against the published parser: '#abc' regex true / library ok; '#abcd' true / ok; '#12345' true / library REJECT; '#abcdef' true / ok; '#1234567' true / library REJECT; '#abcdef12' true / ok. {3,8} admits the two lengths CSS does not define (5 and 7), so garbage passes to a parser that rejects it and triggers the 2s parseError flash (useColorParsing.ts:54-57). `grep -rn '=== "hex"|!== "hex"' demo` -> 11 sites: useColorPipeline.ts:118,176; useColorParsing.ts:66; useSliderGradients.ts:65; useColorNameResolution.ts:43; useColorUrl.ts:55; ColorSpaceSelector.vue:156; readoutReservation.ts:118; ComponentSliders.vue:161; ColorPicker.vue:224.
defects.mechanism: Duplicate semantic ownership — colour syntax is uniquely the library's, and the display-space encoding policy has no single home, so both are re-decided per call site.
defects.reproduction: cd /Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js && node --input-type=module -e "const {parseCssColor}=await import('./dist/subpaths/css.js'); const re=/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$/; for (const s of ['#abc','#abcd','#12345','#abcdef','#1234567','#abcdef12']) console.log(s, re.test(s), parseCssColor(s).ok);"
defects.proposedCure: Delete the regex; call the pipeline unconditionally and let the library's typed ParseResult decide. Give DisplayColorSpace one home — a color-session displaySpace module owning {resolve, format, parse, channels} for the hex encoding — collapsing 11 special cases to 1.

defects.defect: The component's real public surface is a 12-member imperative defineExpose handle reached by template ref; four members have zero consumers, one is never mutated, five are pure pipeline pass-throughs, and two are wired twice with divergent behaviour.
defects.evidence: ColorPicker.vue:331-344. Consumer counts across demo/, test/, e2e/ (excluding the file itself): isTransitioning 0 (declared ref(false) at :330, never mutated anywhere in the repo), parseColor 0, setCurrentColor 0, editTarget 0 (duplicated by the update:editTarget emit at :276). Pass-throughs of inject(COLOR_MODEL_KEY): onPaletteApply, onPaletteAddColor, parseColor, setCurrentColor, applyExternalColor. commitEdit/cancelEdit are wired twice — App.vue:41-42 (which also sets viewManager.mobilePaneIndex.value = 1) and usePaneRouter.ts:156-157 (which does not). usePaletteWiring.ts:21 imports `type { ColorPicker }` purely to spell InstanceType<typeof ColorPicker>, making the leaf's instance type the app's contract.
defects.mechanism: Service-locator public surface: a component instance stands in for an application service, so props/emits/slots stop being the contract and dead members accumulate unnoticed.
defects.reproduction: cd /Users/mkbabb/Programming/value.js && grep -rn 'isTransitioning' demo/ e2e/ test/ (2 hits, both in ColorPicker.vue) && grep -rn '\.parseColor|\.setCurrentColor|\.editTarget' demo/ e2e/ test/ | grep -v ColorPicker.vue (0 hits)
defects.proposedCure: defineExpose goes to zero once L-2 moves the edit session into color-session; the two commit/cancel wirings collapse to one owner.
